semiconductor_relevance: High — Best Compound Semiconductor Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of SiC/SiC epitaxy wafers, which are critical for high voltage and high power semiconductor applications.
summary: Best Compound Semiconductor Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer based in Nanjing, China, focused on providing high-quality SiC/SiC epitaxy wafer services for power devices. Established in 2019, the company aims to become a global leader in wide bandgap epitaxy wafer services, particularly for applications in 5G and electric vehicles.
capabilities: SiC Epitaxy Wafer Service for 6" and 8" wafers
Custom niche product development based on customer requests
High-quality manufacturing for power device applications

regional_presence.China: The company has established its manufacturing plant and R&D headquarters in Nanjing, China.
